title: tier-2 shipped code: the 37-kind state-modifier evaluator against FUN_140cbcbe0
notes: SHIPPED-CODE tier-2 unit. The candidate is crates/ow-sim/src/modifiers.rs (apply_state_modifiers), called by crates/ow-sim/src/bin/verify_probe.rs through the mover_apply_modifiers entry.

The oracle runs FUN_140cbcbe0 (0x140cbcbe0) with the body pinned in the arena and a fake vtable at arena +0x6000; its +0x68/+0x70 slots hold the base-table stubs at their v2b addresses because the oracle maps the raw image without relocations.

body+8 encodes a service block at body+0x1800 whose +0x28 descriptor decodes to null (the end-of-function events then return without a call) and whose +0x118 bit 29 is the guarded-crouch feature bit; the probe receives that bit directly.

Cases: the default path; one set-record per live kind 0x00..0x2e; holes 0x11/0x22 and kinds 0x2f/-1; ops 6/-1; window edges; ops 0..5 on several kinds; NaN bounds; dash windows at id 100..200 with and without the flags; the guarded crouch block on/off; a four-record stack in ascending order.
The two +0x65c bounds are preloaded through the state block from the mutable doubles at 0x1439b1230/0x1439b1270 (2.5 and -1.5).
acknowledgedGaps: The obfuscated service pointer chain from body+8 is not followed by the candidate; the guarded block's feature bit is supplied as an argument, and the state block's +0x118 value in the fixture is the source. The end-of-function events 0x11/0x12 and the 0x142cbd190 notify are external side effects and are not modelled; they do not write the body. The 0xa70 state-array scan and the +0x268 restore are implemented but the fixture seeds count 0, so the copied-entry path is not exercised. Every record's +0x34 is read only by op 5.
